C08-M07-L01-F1.title: The six minisiem rules as design decisions
C08-M07-L01-F1.caption: For each kit rule: its logic family, the fact it relies on, the cheapest evasion and the legitimate activity that looks the same.
C08-M07-L01-F1.alt: Table with columns Rule, Family, Relies on, Easiest evasion and Legitimate look-alike. R1 office_spawns_script, behavioural, orange: Word starting PowerShell or cmd; an unlisted child interpreter; an approved macro running a script. R2 vpn_spray_then_success, behavioural via threshold and sequence, orange: 5 or more users failing from one address, then a success; fewer users per address or many addresses; staff mistyping behind a shared NAT address. R3 new_local_admin, behavioural, orange: events 4720 and 4732; hard without disabling auditing; IT provisioning. R4 large_upload, anomaly with a fixed threshold, blue: one request over 10 MB; splitting into smaller uploads; backups and large legitimate uploads. R5 log_cleared, signature on an OS fact, violet: event 1102; not clearing, or stopping logging another way; approved maintenance. R6 beacon_regular_small, anomaly by regularity, blue: 10 or more same-size requests to one URL; random padding of request size; update checkers and telemetry agents.
rows: 5+ users fail from one IP, then success
Fewer users per IP, many IPs
Do not clear; stop logging otherwise
C08-M07-L01-F1.note: The evasion column predicts false negatives; the look-alike column predicts false positives.

C08-M07-L01-F2.title: One rule, three variants: precision against recall
C08-M07-L01-F2.caption: Alerts produced on the Banyan dataset by three variants of R6, and how many of them were the WS-104 beacon.
C08-M07-L01-F2.alt: Bar chart with three bars. Volume only (hits >= 10), slate: 3 alerts, 1 true. R6 as shipped (hits >= 10 and spread < 50), green: 1 alert, 1 true. Volume >= 20 + spread < 50, red: 0 alerts, beacon missed. Note: the size condition removed the noise; the higher threshold removed the attack.
C08-M07-L01-F2.note: The size condition removed the noise; the higher volume threshold removed the attack.
